title: RetailPulse Sales (synthetic)
description: Historical synthetic demand. Sales value uses each product's current catalog price, not its historical transaction price.

panels.title: Units in selected period
panels.description: Units in forecast.demand_daily; rows retain their SYNTHETIC or LEDGER label.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(units), 0) AS value FROM reporting.sales_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamp) AND ('$location' = 'All' OR location_code = '$location') AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category = '$category')

panels.title: Value at current price
panels.description: This is not historical revenue: every unit is valued with today's catalog price.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(value_at_current_price), 0) AS value FROM reporting.sales_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamp) AND ('$location' = 'All' OR location_code = '$location') AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category = '$category')

panels.title: Synthetic share
panels.description: Share of selected units generated by the synthetic history generator.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(units) FILTER (WHERE source = 'SYNTHETIC')::numeric / nullif(sum(units), 0), 0) AS value FROM reporting.sales_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamp) AND ('$location' = 'All' OR location_code = '$location') AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category = '$category')

SELECT count(DISTINCT location_id) AS value FROM reporting.sales_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamp) AND ('$location' = 'All' OR location_code = '$location') AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category = '$category')

SELECT day::timestamp AS time, sum(units)::double precision AS units FROM reporting.sales_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamp) AND ('$location' = 'All' OR location_code = '$location') AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category = '$category') GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Top products
panels.description: Value is at current catalog price.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sku AS "SKU", product_name AS "Product", sum(units)::integer AS "Units", sum(value_at_current_price)::numeric(14,2) AS "Value" FROM reporting.sales_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamp) AND ('$location' = 'All' OR location_code = '$location') AND ('$category' = 'All' OR category = '$category') GROUP BY sku, product_name ORDER BY "Units" DESC LIMIT 15

list.name: location
list.label: Store
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT location_code AS __text, location_code AS __value FROM reporting.sales_daily ORDER BY 1

list.name: category
list.label: Category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT category AS __text, category AS __value FROM reporting.sales_daily ORDER BY 1
